prompts.text: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this workout illustration into the raised phase of a bent-arm barbell pullover. Keep the exact same man, face, black shirt and shorts with orange piping, shoes, flat perforated metal bench, and pixel framing. Change ONLY arms and held barbell: rotate bent arms upward from shoulders so hands and bar are above the chest, upper arms near vertical with slight elbow bend. Keep the SAME foreshortened barbell camera perspective, large left plate and smaller far right plate, same bar length and plate sizes as input; do not turn it into a broad frontal barbell. All stationary pixels, especially bench, head, torso, knees, shoes and feet must stay at their original positions and sizes. Transparent background with real alpha, no checkerboard, no floor, no labels. Output 1024x768.
prompts.outcome: Rejected RGB checkerboard and framing drift.

prompts.text: Precise-object-edit of attached workout animation frame. Preserve the exact 4:3 composition and ALL the stationary man and bench coordinates. Keep solid pure GREEN #00FF00 background everywhere including bench holes and arm gaps. NO checkerboard or shadows. Change only arm pose to the raised chest position of a bent-arm barbell pullover: rotate his two arms and bar upward so his hands sit above his upper chest, near x400 y265 on this 1024x768 reference. Elbows retain a slight bend. Maintain exact reference barbell perspective: near left black plate 140 pixels diameter, far right plate 90 pixels diameter, hand spacing and foreshortened bar. Do not increase bar span. Bench top remains x286..849 y548..590, left foot x288 y755, right shoe ends x890 y750, head center x311 y499, shoulder x385 y501, shorts at x610..753. These are immovable. Same face, black clothes, orange piping, shoes, linework. No recentering, zoom, changed body or bench. Output single frame on solid green.
